<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Antonio Mota Junior — Perfil</title>
<meta name="description" content="Desenvolvedor Full Stack · PHP · Python · JavaScript · APIs REST · Web · RPA · Visão Computacional · IA">
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#0d1117; --bg2:#161b22; --border:#30363d; --text:#e6edf3; --muted:#8b949e;
    --link:#4493f8; --accent:#2f81f7; --hl:rgba(47,129,247,.18);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
  body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);
    font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
    font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;padding:24px 12px 48px}
  a{color:var(--link);text-decoration:none}
  a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
  .readme{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:32px 40px 36px}
  .readme h1{font-size:2em;margin:0 0 16px;padding-bottom:.3em;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-weight:600}
  .readme h2{font-size:1.5em;margin:28px 0 16px;padding-bottom:.3em;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-weight:600}
  .readme h3{font-size:1.25em;margin:24px 0 12px;font-weight:600}
  .readme p{margin:0 0 16px}
  .readme ul{margin:0 0 16px;padding-left:2em}
  .readme li+li{margin-top:.25em}
  .readme hr{height:.25em;padding:0;margin:24px 0;background:var(--border);border:0}
  .readme img{max-width:100%}
  .readme blockquote{margin:0 0 16px;padding:0 1em;color:var(--muted);border-left:.25em solid var(--border)}
  .readme blockquote strong{color:var(--text)}
  .header-img{float:right;width:210px;margin:0 0 8px 16px}
  .clear{clear:both}
  .badges img,.badges-block img{height:20px;vertical-align:middle;margin:0 2px 4px 0}
  .center{text-align:center}
  .center img{height:165px;margin:0 4px}

  /* ---- imagem mapeada ---- */
  .stage{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:760px;aspect-ratio:1/1;margin:0 auto 8px;
    border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg2)}
  .stage>img{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;object-fit:cover;user-select:none}
  .hs-zone{position:absolute;border:1.5px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;padding:0;
    transition:background .2s,border-color .2s}
  .hs-zone:hover,.hs-zone:focus-visible{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--hl);outline:none}
  .hs-zone span{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:4px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--bg2);
    border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);font-size:12px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:6px;white-space:nowrap;
    opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .2s}
  .hs-zone:hover span,.hs-zone:focus-visible span{opacity:1}
  .hs-dot{position:absolute;width:3.2%;height:3.2%;min-width:18px;min-height:18px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
    border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--accent);background:rgba(47,129,247,.3);cursor:pointer;padding:0;
    animation:pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
  .hs-dot:hover,.hs-dot:focus-visible{background:rgba(47,129,247,.75);outline:none}
  @keyframes pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(47,129,247,.55)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(47,129,247,0)}}
  .hint{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin:6px 0 0}

  /* ---- modal ---- */
  .overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;
    background:rgba(1,4,9,.8)}
  .overlay.open{display:flex}
  .modal{position:relative;width:min(620px,100%);max-height:88vh;overflow:auto;background:var(--bg);
    border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:24px 26px 22px;box-shadow:0 8px 40px rgba(1,4,9,.85)}
  .modal h2{font-size:1.35em;margin:0 36px 4px 0;padding:0;border:0}
  .modal .sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;margin-bottom:14px}
  .modal h4{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin:18px 0 8px;font-weight:600}
  .modal ul{margin:0;padding-left:1.4em;font-size:15px}
  .modal .chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
  .modal .chips span{font-size:12.5px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg2);border-radius:2em;padding:2px 10px}
  .modal .links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:18px}
  .modal .links a{font-size:13px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:4px 12px;background:var(--bg2);font-weight:500}
  .modal .links a:hover{border-color:var(--link);text-decoration:none}
  .close{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--bg2);
    border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--muted);font-size:16px;cursor:pointer}
  .close:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:var(--link)}

  @media (max-width:600px){
    .readme{padding:20px 16px 24px}
    .header-img{float:none;display:block;margin:0 auto 12px}
    .hs-zone span{display:none}
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important}}
</style>
</head>

  ];

    ["Pipeline RPA Dinâmico & Analítico de Dados","Automação de processos e tratamento de dados, com geração de informações estruturadas para análise e tomada de decisão."],
    ["Sistema de Gestão Financeira e Manutenção Patrimonial","Aplicação web para controle financeiro, patrimônio, manutenção e acompanhamento operacional."],

    ["Sistema de Gestão de Turnos e Plantões Familiares","Organização de escalas, turnos e plantões, com foco em praticidade e controle das atividades."],

  ];
  const DATA={
    about:{
      title:"Antonio Mota Junior",
      sub:"Desenvolvedor Full Stack · PHP · Python · JavaScript",
      text:"Desenvolvedor Full Stack com foco na criação de sistemas web, APIs, automações e soluções orientadas a dados, combinando desenvolvimento de software, RPA, visão computacional e Inteligência Artificial. Interesse em transformar processos reais em aplicações práticas.",

    },

    },

  const ZONES=[

    const d=DATA[key]; if(!d) return;
    last=from;
    let h=`<h2 id="m-title">${esc(d.title)}</h2><div class="sub">${esc(d.sub)}</div><p>${esc(d.text)}</p>`;
    if(d.tags) h+=`<h4>Competências</h4><div class="chips">${d.tags.map(t=>`<span>${esc(t)}</span>`).join("")}</div>`;
    if(d.items) h+=`<h4>${esc(d.itemsTitle||"Projetos")}</h4><ul>${d.items.map(p=>`<li><strong>${esc(p[0])}</strong> — ${esc(p[1])}</li>`).join("")}</ul>`;
    if(d.showOthers) h+=`<h4>Outros projetos</h4><ul>${OTHERS.map(o=>`<li><a href="${repo(o[1])}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${esc(o[0])}</a></li>`).join("")}</ul>`;
    const links=d.onlyLinks?d.links.concat([["GitHub",GH]]):(d.links||[]).concat(LINKS);
    h+=`<div class="links">${links.map(l=>`<a href="${l[1]}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${esc(l[0])}</a>`).join("")}</div>`;
    content.innerHTML=h;
    overlay.classList.add("open");
    closeBtn.focus();
  }
  function closeM(){overlay.classList.remove("open");if(last)last.focus();}
  closeBtn.addEventListener("click",closeM);
  overlay.addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target===overlay)closeM();});
  document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Escape"&&overlay.classList.contains("open"))closeM();});
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
